blocker.detail: Backend Java compilation could not be completed: mvnw.cmd fails before Maven startup with "Cannot index into a null array" / "Cannot start maven from wrapper"; global mvn is not installed; java is not on PATH.
blocker.resolution: Provide a working Java/Maven runtime or repair the Maven wrapper bootstrap, then run services/backend/mvnw.cmd -pl access,boot -am -DskipTests compile.
blocker.worker_result_evidence: mvn -version: command not recognized; java -version: command not recognized; .\mvnw.cmd and cmd /c mvnw.cmd both fail before Maven starts. Verified instead: pytest tests/test_r15_recovery_static.py passed 5 tests; scripts/check_api_contract.py returned API_CONTRACT_OK.

summary: Implemented the R15 recovery slice for notifications, announcements, help articles, support tickets, admin support actions, chat report decisions, idempotency, audit/outbox writes, and V049 RBAC/table alignment. Targeted regression tests and OpenAPI contract check pass, but candidate readiness is blocked because Java/Maven compilation cannot run in this environment.
